items.briefing:
Users of Anthropic's AI tools (such as Claude) are being targeted by information-stealing malware that can hijack active sessions, meaning attackers may gain access to your account without needing your password. This is a timely reminder that AI platforms are increasingly attractive targets. Separately, security vendors including Proofpoint and SentinelOne are expanding their Australian operations in response to growing AI-related data risks, signalling that local organisations are seen as increasingly exposed.

If you use any AI platforms for work, make sure you log out of sessions when finished and report any unexpected account activity to your IT team promptly.

featured.title: SentinelOne launches AI security monitoring in Sydney
featured.summary: Local hosting in Sydney eases compliance worries for Australian firms using AI tools that may expose prompts, code and credentials.
